title: SearchProvenance
description: One executed search run, as 07-architecture-and-data-model.md §5.3 declares it and 10-requirements-and-user-stories.md FR-8 requires it. Generated from src/core/provenance.ts: every property below is a field of that file's SearchProvenance, SourceProvenance or MergeDecision interface, and test/unit/core/provenance.test.ts fails if the two drift apart. A field is in `required` exactly when the interface cannot hold `undefined` for it, because JSON.stringify omits an `undefined`-valued member.

schemaVersion.description: §5.3: the literal 1. Schema version of this record, independent of the plugin version.

userQuery.description: The user's query before per-source translation (FR-4), with credential-shaped runs redacted (NFR-16).

dateFilter.description: The resolved recency window, or "none" when the user chose "All years" (FR-3).

targetCollectionKey.description: Absent when the run targeted no collection; the interface types it `string | undefined`.

perSource.description: FR-8's per-source enumeration, one entry per source that was asked.

totals.description: Run totals. `deduplicatedAway` is 0, not absent, when only one source ran (§5.3; FR-8 requires the counts "even when they are zero").

mergeDecisions.description: FR-50 scenario 2 (07-architecture-and-data-model.md §5.3, added 2026-10-15): one entry per merge the dedup cascade made. An empty array, not absent, when nothing merged.

sourceId.description: The SourceId union of src/model/ids.ts, in the union's declaration order.

endpointBaseUrl.description: Endpoint base URL, without query string (FR-8).

transmittedQuery.description: The transmitted query string, with API keys redacted (FR-4, FR-8, NFR-16). No leading "?".

transmittedUrl.description: The exact transmitted URL, with API keys redacted (FR-4, NFR-16).

dateFilterApplied.description: "server" when the source filtered, "client" when we did (FR-3), "none".

rawHitCount.description: Raw hit count the source reported, before any local filtering. Absent when the source reported none; the interface types it `number | undefined`.

recordsDeduplicatedAway.description: 0, not absent, in a single-source run (§5.3; FR-8 requires it "even when they are zero").

error.description: Populated when the source failed or degraded; absent on a clean run.

sourceExtras.description: Source-specific extras keyed by the source's own field names — e.g. PubMed's count, querytranslation and translationset (02-literature-database-apis.md §12.4). Never a credential, never a raw body, so the values are unconstrained but every string in them has been through §2.1's redaction.

workKey.description: CanonicalWork.workKey of the merged work the decision folded a record into.

tier.description: The tier that fired, by name: "doi", "pmid", …, "title-fuzzy" (DedupTierId, src/sources/shared/dedupe.ts).

evidence.description: Flat facts behind the decision: the matched identifier, a similarity, the rule. Every string has been through §2.1's redaction.

SerializedError.title: SerializedError
SerializedError.description: 07-architecture-and-data-model.md §5.2's wire form of a thrown error, as src/core/errors.ts declares it. Part of an exported artefact because §5.3 stores one here.
